title: 航空材料力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Mechanics of Materials for Aeronautics I
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1) Bars with circular cross section under torsional moment
(2) Stress-strain relationship for 3D elastic body and elastic
    bodies under plane-stress or plane-strain conditions
(3) Normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of
    slender bar under uniaxial tensile load
(4) Combined stress problem
advice:
On the basis of 'Industrial Mechanics' and 'Strength of Materials', students will study advanced topics
in Strength of Materials.
We will cover the following materials:

(1) Torsion of bars with circular cross section
(2) Relationship between stress and strain (for 3D elastic body or 2D elastic body under plane-stress
    or plane-strain)
(3) Normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar under uniaxial tensile load
(4) Combined stress problem (principal stresses and principal shear stress, Mohr's stress circle)

Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in  'Industrial Mechanics' and
'Strength of Materials' before taking this course.
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of industrial mechanics and mechanics of materials.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate torsional stiffness and shear stress of bars with circular cross sections
Be able to express the relationship between stresses and strains for plane-stress and plane-strain
Be able to calculate normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar under tension
Be able to calculate principal stresses and principal shear stress of thin flat plate under in-plane load
Be able to draw the Mohr's stress circle and obtain principal stress and principal shear stress from it

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Accurately calculate the torsional stiffness and
    the torsional stress of bars with circular
    cross section
(2) Express the relationship between stresses and
    strains for plane-stress and plane-strain
(3) Accurately calculate normal and shear stresses
    on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar
(4) Accurately calculate principal stresses and
    principal shear stress
(5) Draw the Mohr's stress circle and obtain
    principal stress and principal shear stress
    from it
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Calculate the torsional stiffness of bars with
    circular cross section
(2) Explain the difference between stresses and
    strains for plane-stress and plane-strain
(3) Calculate normal and shear stresses on an
    arbitrary cross section of slender bar under
    uniaxial tensile load
(4) Explain the meaning of technical terms 'principal
    stresses' and ‘principal shear stress’
(5) Draw the Mohr's stress circle
